items.text: Validate frame (b): persistent bootstrap identity with graduated (non-exclusive) authority — the chosen approach over dissolution(a)/rotating(c)
Name the bootstrap steward as the initial constitutional-tier steward at DNA install time in bootstrap_steward.rs module docs
Keep code as-is: do NOT add integrity-zome validators gating on is_bootstrap_steward; gate on StewardshipGrant tier+scope instead
Document the scaffolding gap openly: until StewardshipGrant validation is wired, authority defaults to bootstrap pubkey by lack-of-alternative (temporary, must close before first non-alpha network)
Bootstrap-steward externs return identity only; capability checks must use the future steward-grant resolution layer
Propagate the identity-only / constitutional-tier docstring across all four ported modules (imagodei reference + mishpat + node-registry + lamad/content_store) for frame consistency
Deferred: implement StewardshipGrant-based validators in mishpat, node-registry, and lamad (per-DNA design exercise, with each DNA's feature sprints)
Deferred: cross-DNA constitutional-tier bootstrapping question (does imagodei constitutional steward hold mishpat constitutional? per-DNA sovereign stewardship chain) — wants its own memo
Sweettest: bootstrap-steward identifiable; second agent is not bootstrap steward; coordinator get_bootstrap_steward returns install-time pubkey (identity-contract assertions)
